question: MTP (Multi-Token Prediction) x4 的实际加速比 Speedup_MTP = (S_base + S_verify_overhead) / (S_base / Acceptance_Rate + S_draft_gen_latency)，其中 Acceptance_Rate 需在 Qwen3.8-27B 典型科研 Prompt 分布下实测（预期范围 0.5-0.8），S_verify_overhead 为 V100 TP=4 下批量验证 4 个 token 的额外延迟（估算 5-15ms/batch），S_draft_gen_latency 为生成 4 个草稿 token 的延迟（估算 20-40ms）。

sources.title: Efficient and Robust Drafting with Multi-Token Prediction
sources.snippet: A crucial challenge is therefore designing a drafter that is both lightweight and accurate enough to approximate the predictions of the target model. We present a highly optimized Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) architecture that extends existing backbone LLMs to efficiently produce high-quality drafts.
